title: PackReprocessingRequestedPayload
description: Payload of the PackReprocessingRequested platform event (INV-REQ-1003, INV-REQ-1004; class: platform; contract task INV-T-24001, coordinator ruling on the coder stop of INV-T-4978): rules-svc asks canonical-svc for the population of a reprocessing run after a pack correction. The tenant is the envelope attribute tenantid (API-40), not a payload property. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

reprocessingId.description: The reprocessing run the request starts.

entityRef.description: The entity whose documents are selected.

packType.description: The pack type that was corrected.

badPackVersion.description: Version of the bad pack; documents whose current canonical version was evaluated under it are selected.

supersedingPackVersion.description: Version of the superseding pack the documents are reprocessed under.

effectiveFrom.description: Documents with a transaction date on or after this date are selected.
